scope: Isolated React/Chromium CityInput harness; not a deployed-page test
checks: Arabic spelling selects the stable city ID using ArrowDown and Enter
Duplicate cities show their province and ambiguous same-province cities show county
Unknown manual entry is retained and clears the prior selected ID; manual action supports Tab
Results, no-match state and validation do not move the next control at mobile and desktop widths
Keyboard traversal scrolls only the suggestion list and retains a visible active option
